title: Localizing a Noetherian ring at an associated prime gives a local ring whose maximal ideal is associated
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $\mathfrak q\subset R$ a prime ideal which is an associated prime of $R$, i.e. $\mathfrak q=\operatorname{Ann}_R(z)=\{a\in R: az=0\}$ for some $z\in R$. Let $R_{\mathfrak q}$ be the localization of $R$ at $\mathfrak q$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], a local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak qR_{\mathfrak q}$. Then $\mathfrak qR_{\mathfrak q}$ is an associated prime of $R_{\mathfrak q}$: there is $w\in R_{\mathfrak q}$ with $\operatorname{Ann}_{R_{\mathfrak q}}(w)=\mathfrak qR_{\mathfrak q}$.
